# SECTION 08 11 13 — HOLLOW METAL DOORS AND FRAMES

## 1.1 General

Provide hollow metal doors and frames complete with hardware, anchors, seals, and installation. Coordinate openings with the architectural plans and the door schedule.

## 2.1 Performance

Doors serving electrical, mechanical, janitor, and other service rooms opening onto the public corridor shall be 45 minute fire-rated assemblies unless a code-compliant exception is identified in the issued documents.

## 2.2 Hardware

Provide closer and latchset at rated service-room doors. Hardware group designations in the Door Schedule identify the base hardware set; final handing and keying are to be coordinated before fabrication.

## 3.1 Execution

Install rated assemblies in accordance with the listing and frame manufacturer's requirements. Verify wall construction and opening dimensions before release of shop drawings.
